criteria.title: Readable complete bundle
criteria.description: The requested manifest and referenced non-empty weights artifact are readable and identify the supplied checkpoint.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Target-compatible HQQ configuration
criteria.description: The package uses calibration-free HQQ on the requested axis, selects the preferred optimized T4 backend, covers every layer, preserves the vocabulary endpoints, and uses only permitted precisions and group sizes.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Quantized weight payload integrity
criteria.description: Every source row is represented exactly once; protected weights remain intact; and all HQQ groups, codes, scales, zero points, including partial tail groups, are the deterministic result of the selected configuration.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Quality limits and minimum package
criteria.description: Reconstruction from the submitted payload satisfies every per-layer RMSE limit and byte ceiling, and the selected mixed-precision plan minimizes packed bytes with the stated RMSE tie-break.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Manifest-to-payload consistency
criteria.description: Reported layer and overall RMSE, source and packed sizes, per-layer bytes, and reduction percentage reconcile to the submitted weights artifact.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
